ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows trapezoid DEGH, with upper base DE and lower base HG. The lower base HG is labeled as 32. There are points X and Y on the two legs of the trapezoid respectively, and segment XY connects the two legs and is parallel to the two bases; in the figure, XY is labeled as 20. The problem states that X and Y are the midpoints of the two legs. Reasoning: Because X and Y are the midpoints of the two legs of the trapezoid, XY is the midline of the trapezoid. The length of the midline of a trapezoid is equal to the average of the lengths of the two bases, so 20 = (DE + 32) / 2. Multiplying both sides by 2 gives 40 = DE + 32, so DE = 40 - 32 = 8.
